许默抬起左手，工蜂和工兵蚁交换信息。

被蜂后打下精神标记的工蜂瞬间振翅，化作一道微小的黄黑残影，一头撞进外头越发浓稠的夜色中。

离开庇护所的光源，森林立刻露出了它的狰狞。

越往深处走，林木就越发粗壮高大。

遮天蔽日的树冠交织在一起，组成一张密不透风的黑色巨网，将天光抹杀在林子外面。

空气里弥漫着令人窒息的阴凉，夹杂着一股腐烂落叶味。

两人的脚步极轻，靴底踩在松软的腐殖质上，发出闷响。

许默扫视着四周，绝不放过任何有价值的东西。

路过一截爬满墨绿斑块的枯木，他手腕翻转，锋利的石斧无声斩下，剥下几团厚重坚韧的苔藓。

半空中垂落的带刺藤蔓，也被他随手斩断收入空间。

忽然，一抹突兀的色彩猛地刺入他的余光。

那是一小片藏在巨树根部阴影里的蘑菇。

紫红色的伞盖上，布满了犹如人眼般的苍白斑点，在极暗的光线下散发着一层微弱的诡异光晕。

【致幻蘑菇（绿色）】

【特性：极度危险。动物一旦误食，精神将被彻底拖入深渊，沉溺于疯狂的幻境无法自拔。】

好东西。

许默蹲下身，摸出一块削薄的木片，小心翼翼地贴着泥土边缘插进去，连根带土将其完整撬起，意念一动，直接收入储物空间。

有了这玩意儿，万一以后遇到体型庞大的茬子，完全可以送一场好梦给对方尝尝。

继续向前推进。

周围的环境越来越惊悚。

静得让人头皮发麻。

原本还能偶尔听见的虫鸣、远处的鸟叫，不知从什么时候起，连风都停止了流动。

领路的工蜂突然停了下来。

它在半空中狂躁地打着转，翅膀震动的频率彻底乱了套，死活不肯再往前飞出半步。

几秒钟后，它收拢翅膀，直挺挺地落回许默的肩头，一动不动。

到了。

许默打了个手势，身子瞬间压低，无声无息地贴近前方一棵大树。

方芸紧随其后，身形半蹲，将自己完全藏进灌木丛中，拇指已经死死扣住了弓弦。

两人借助树干的阴影掩护，微微偏过头，屏住呼吸，目光穿过交错的枝蔓向前方探去。

仅仅只看了一眼。

Xu Mo raised his left hand, and the worker bees and worker ants exchanged information.

The worker bee that had been mentally marked by the queen flapped its wings instantly and turned into a tiny yellow-black afterimage, crashing into the increasingly dense night outside.

Leaving the light source of the shelter, the forest immediately revealed its ferocity.

The deeper you go, the thicker and taller the trees become.

The tree crowns that cover the sky and the sun are intertwined to form a huge airtight black network, obliterating the skylight outside the forest.

The air was filled with a suffocating coolness, mixed with the smell of rotting leaves.

The steps of the two were extremely light, and the soles of their boots made a muffled sound when they stepped on the soft humus.

Xu Mo glanced around, never letting go of anything valuable.

Passing by a dead tree covered with dark green patches, he flipped his wrist and silently chopped down with the sharp stone ax, peeling off several thick and tough moss.

The thorny vines hanging in mid-air were also cut off by him and put into the space.

Suddenly, a sudden color suddenly penetrated his peripheral vision.

It was a small patch of mushroom hidden in the shadow of the roots of a giant tree.

The purple-red umbrella cover is covered with pale spots like human eyes, emitting a faint and strange halo in the extremely dark light.

【Psychedelic mushrooms (green)】

[Characteristics: Extremely dangerous.Once an animal eats it by mistake, its spirit will be completely dragged into the abyss, and it will be addicted to a crazy fantasy and unable to extricate itself.】

nice one.

Xu Mo squatted down, took out a thin piece of wood, carefully inserted it against the edge of the soil, pried it up completely with the roots and soil, and put it directly into the storage space with a thought.

With this thing, if you encounter a huge stubble in the future, you can give him a good dream.

Keep pushing forward.

The surrounding environment is getting more and more terrifying.

It was so quiet that it made my head tingle.

I could still occasionally hear the chirping of insects and the chirping of birds in the distance, but at some point, even the wind stopped flowing.

The leading worker bee suddenly stopped.

It was spinning wildly in mid-air, the vibration frequency of its wings was completely out of whack, and it refused to fly even half a step forward.

After a few seconds, it folded its wings and landed straight back on Xu Mo's shoulder, motionless.

arrive.

Xu Mo made a gesture, lowered his body instantly, and silently approached a big tree in front of him.

Fang Yun followed closely behind, half-crouching, completely hiding herself in the bushes, her thumb already tightly clasping the bow string.

The two of them took advantage of the shadow of the tree trunks, tilted their heads slightly, held their breath, and looked forward through the intertwined branches.

Just a glance.
